svg.title: Cadet Colonel insignia on cloth (1/8 in border), miniature
svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"rank-cadet-officer-colonel-cloth-bordered-miniature","name":"Cadet Colonel insignia on cloth (1/8 in border), miniature","size_in":{"w":1.25,"h":0.75},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,125,75],"size_source":"regulation","size_citation":"CAPR 39-1 (3 March 2020) Figure A5-6, dimension drawing (inches read from the figure); border: CAPR 39-1 5.1.1.1.1.1 / 5.1.1.1.1.3 (ABU) and 7.1.1.8 (OCP/tactical cap), 1/8 in showing past the widest and tallest point","anchors":{"top_center":[62.5,0],"bottom_center":[62.5,75],"center":[62.5,37.5],"left_edge":[0,37.5],"right_edge":[125,37.5],"insignia_center":[62.5,37.5],"insignia_left":[12.5,37.5],"insignia_right":[112.5,37.5]},"dimensions":{"form":"embroidered on cloth","size":"miniature","border_each_side_in":0.125,"insignia_w_in":1,"insignia_h_in":0.5,"cloth_w_in":1.25,"cloth_h_in":0.75},"mounts":[{"uniform":"ABU / BDU / blue field coat collar","rule":"regular size (Colonels and Captains may wear miniature), centered 1 in from the FRONT of the collar, 1/8 in of blue showing past the widest and tallest point (5.1.1.1.1.3, 5.1.2.2.4, 5.2.1.1.1.4). Orientation as drawn: field-grade long points vertical, company-grade circles in a horizontal row (6.2.9.2 / 6.1.10.2.2)"},{"uniform":"OCP / ABU / BDU / blue field / navy tactical cap","rule":"cadet officers only (cadet NCOs and Airmen wear none, 7.1.1.8): centered on the front, 1/2 in from the visor, 1/8 in of blue showing (7.1.1.8, 5.1.2.2.5, 5.2.1.1.1.5, 6.2.11)"},{"uniform":"green / black fleece (front)","rule":"dark blue material, centered horizontally, long points of field grade vertical, company-grade circles added horizontally (6.1.10.2.2, 6.1.14.4.2)"}],"cloth_color":{"hex":"#142347","basis":"sampled from CAPR 39-1 p.136 cloth figure; regulation calls it dark blue"},"rank":{"grade":"Cadet Colonel","abbrev":"C/Col","membership":"cadet"},"grade":"rank-insignia"}
